numbers.label: Number 20
numbers.movement_rule: Index finger and Thumb extended in an 'L' shape, repeatedly tapping/closing tips together.

numbers.label: Number 21
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' handshape and transition to Index finger upright ('1').

numbers.label: Number 22
numbers.movement_rule: Hold '2' handshape (Index and Middle upright) and pulse outward twice.

numbers.label: Number 23
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' / '2' handshape and transition to '3' (Thumb, Index, Middle extended).

numbers.label: Number 24
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' / '2' handshape and transition to 4 fingers upright with thumb tucked.

numbers.label: Number 25
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' / '2' handshape and open to 5 fingers spread wide.

numbers.label: Number 26
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' handshape and transition to Thumb touching Pinky tip.

numbers.label: Number 27
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' handshape and transition to Thumb touching Ring tip.

numbers.label: Number 28
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' handshape and transition to Thumb touching Middle tip.

numbers.label: Number 29
numbers.movement_rule: Begin with 'L' handshape and transition to Thumb touching Index tip with wrist twist.

numbers.label: Number 30
numbers.movement_rule: Hold '3' handshape and close fingers into an 'O' shape.
